R465.anchor: driving energy comes primarily from the expansion of water as the reservoir is produced

R685.anchor: if the aquifer bounds the edges of the oil zone it is called edge water drive and if the water bounds the base of the oil reservoir it is called bottom water drive

R360.anchor: a positive value of skin factor will indicate that the permeability around the well has been reduced

D314.anchor: To prevent mud contamination of the cement a spacer fluid is pumped ahead of the cement slurry

D341.anchor: A VDL (variable density log), provides the wavetrain of the received signal

D496.anchor: it records a True North bearing which does not require correction for magnetic declination

P1279.anchor: perforations through the wall of the casing and the cement sheath

P1164.anchor: contains an offcentre pocket with ports into the annulus

P2162.anchor: An IPO valve uses the injection or casing pressure

P2057.anchor: the upward (gas) flow velocity has decreased so much

P2276.anchor: increased water saturation (water block) in the near wellbore area

FE132.anchor: sonic-derived porosity may be too high because of fluid effect

FE100.anchor: mudcakes can be anisotropic, with mudcake resistivity parallel to the borehole wall less than that across the mudcake

FE103.anchor: microlaterolog reading depends mostly on the value of Rxo

SIM164.anchor: taking this derivative at the (n+1) time level

WT144.anchor: pressure is measured in an inactive observation well some distance

WT486.anchor: values can range from zero (sealing fault) to high values indicating negligible resistance to flow across the fault

WT356.anchor: the WFT tool is correctly depth matched to the open-hole logs

WT417.anchor: mud hydrostatic readings should fall on a very good straight line

LV344.document: Larry W. Lake - Petroleum Engineering Handbook, Volume V (1).pdf
LV344.anchor: NMR tools have shallow depths of investigation and provide results only for the invaded zone

L3198.anchor: This occurs in a reclaimer vessel

L3473.anchor: The kVA capacity of a generator is determined by dividing the kW by the power factor

L2450.anchor: cause of shale instability is two-fold: mechanical

tasks.question: In a water-drive reservoir, what aquifer process can supply expansion energy as oil is produced? Cite the internal source.
tasks.reference_answer: Expansion of water in the connected aquifer can drive reservoir fluids during production.
expected_claims: Aquifer water expansion can provide drive energy during production.

tasks.question: 사이드 포켓 맨드렐의 포켓은 튜빙 중심에 있나요, 한쪽으로 치우쳐 있나요? 내부 자료로 답해줘.
tasks.reference_answer: 한쪽으로 치우친 포켓이며 애눌러스와 연결되는 포트가 있다.
expected_claims: The side-pocket mandrel has an off-centre pocket with annulus ports.

tasks.question: A cement-bond VDL records what kind of received signal information beyond a simple amplitude curve?
tasks.reference_answer: It records the received acoustic wavetrain (variable-density display).
expected_claims: VDL provides the received acoustic wavetrain.

tasks.question: Gyro single-shot survey에서 자기편각 보정이 불필요한 이유는 무엇인가?
tasks.reference_answer: 자이로 컴퍼스 카드가 진북 방위를 기록하기 때문이다.
expected_claims: The gyroscope records true north, so magnetic declination correction is not needed.

tasks.question: According to the handbook, does an NMR log investigate the invaded zone or the virgin zone directly?
tasks.reference_answer: NMR has shallow investigation and directly reflects the invaded zone, not the virgin zone.
expected_claims: NMR directly samples the invaded zone due to shallow investigation.

tasks.question: 정수압식 P=0.052×MW×TVD에서 MW의 단위와 TVD의 단위를 교재 기준으로 알려줘.
tasks.reference_answer: MW는 mud weight의 ppg, TVD는 진수직깊이 ft이며 P는 psi이다.
expected_claims: MW is mud density in ppg.
TVD is true vertical depth in ft.
The calculated hydrostatic pressure is in psi.

tasks.question: An aquifer contacts both the flank and base of an oil zone. Explain the two geometric water-drive labels and one physical source of drive energy, citing internal material.
tasks.reference_answer: Aquifer contact at the edge is edge-water drive; contact at the base is bottom-water drive. Expansion of aquifer water can supply drive energy.
expected_claims: Edge contact is edge-water drive; base contact is bottom-water drive.
Aquifer-water expansion can supply drive energy.

tasks.question: 가스 리프트용 side-pocket mandrel의 역할과 IPO/TPO 밸브를 여는 압력의 차이를 함께 설명해줘.
tasks.reference_answer: 사이드 포켓은 밸브 설치 및 애눌러스-튜빙 유로를 제공한다. IPO는 주입/케이싱 압력, TPO는 튜빙 압력에 반응한다.
expected_claims: The side pocket houses a valve and connects to annulus ports.
IPO responds to injection/casing pressure whereas TPO responds to tubing pressure.

tasks.question: After casing cementing, why might an engineer review both perforating design and a VDL before putting the interval on production?
tasks.reference_answer: Perforations create the intended path through casing/cement into the formation; VDL helps assess bonding of casing-cement and cement-formation, which informs completion integrity. It does not by itself prove productivity.
expected_claims: Perforating creates communication through casing and cement into the formation.
VDL provides cement-bond evidence across casing/cement and cement/formation interfaces.

tasks.question: A well has positive skin after completion. Explain what this suggests near the wellbore and why a poorly designed matrix treatment could make matters worse.
tasks.reference_answer: Positive skin suggests reduced near-well permeability/formation damage. A treatment can mobilize fines or create a water block, further restricting flow.
expected_claims: Positive skin indicates reduced near-well permeability or damage.
A treatment may mobilize fines or cause a water block and worsen near-well flow.

tasks.question: WFT 압력-깊이 해석 전에 깊이 품질 확인과 이수 정수압 판독의 선형성 확인이 각각 왜 필요한가?
tasks.reference_answer: WFT 깊이는 개방공 로그와 일치하고 MD→TVD 변환이 정확해야 한다. 이수 정수압 점들의 직선 기울기는 이수 밀도/압력계 품질 확인에 쓰인다.
expected_claims: WFT depth matching and measured-to-true-vertical-depth conversion must be checked.
Mud hydrostatic pressure readings should form a near-straight line, supporting gradient/transducer QC.

tasks.question: Why can mixing drilling mud with a cement slurry leave a poor bond around casing?
tasks.reference_answer: Mud-cement mixing increases viscosity; the hard-to-displace mixture forms annular channels, preventing a uniform cement bond. A spacer is pumped ahead of slurry to reduce contamination.
expected_claims: Mud-cement mixing raises viscosity and promotes hard-to-displace annular channels.
Channels can cause poor circumferential cement bonding; a spacer reduces contamination.

tasks.question: 고탄화수소 포화 암석에서 sonic-derived porosity가 실제보다 높게 나올 수 있는 물리적 이유는?
tasks.reference_answer: 오일·가스의 음속이 물보다 낮아 transit time이 커진다. 물로 포화됐다고 가정한 변환은 이 경우 공극률을 과대평가할 수 있다.
expected_claims: Oil/gas have lower acoustic velocity (higher transit time) than water.
A water-saturation sonic transform may overstate porosity in such rocks.

tasks.question: Why can installing larger tubing eventually reduce liquid-lifting ability even if frictional pressure loss falls?
tasks.reference_answer: At sufficiently large diameter the upward gas velocity falls, liquid slips/holdup develops, and liquid loading impairs lift.
expected_claims: Larger tubing can lower gas velocity enough to cause liquid slip and holdup.
Liquid loading can offset the earlier pressure-loss benefit.

tasks.question: 셰일 불안정성을 이수 밀도만으로 설명할 수 없는 이유를 기계적·화학적 경로로 나누어 설명해줘.
tasks.reference_answer: 기계적 경로는 굴착 후 응력 평형 변화와 이수 지지 부족이다. 화학적 경로는 이수-셰일 상호작용으로 모세관압·삼투압·압력 확산·유체 침입이 강도와 공극압을 바꾼다.
expected_claims: Mechanical instability involves altered in-situ stresses and inadequate mud support.
Chemical instability includes mud-shale interaction such as capillary/osmotic effects and invasion.

tasks.question: Why does an amine gas-sweetening unit need a reclaimer even though absorption reactions can be reversible?
tasks.reference_answer: Some side reactions are nonreversible and form degradation compounds; the reclaimer removes those compounds by distillation.
expected_claims: Some amine reactions form nonreversible degradation compounds.
A reclaimer removes degradation products by distillation.

tasks.question: Compare a microlog with a microlaterolog when Rxo/Rmc is high: which is more responsive to Rxo and why?
tasks.reference_answer: The microlog responds little to Rxo because current escapes through mudcake; microlaterolog current enters the permeable formation and reflects Rxo more strongly.
expected_claims: At high Rxo/Rmc, microlog has weak Rxo response due to mudcake current escape.
Microlaterolog current enters formation and responds mainly to Rxo.

tasks.question: IPO와 TPO gas-lift valve의 개폐를 주도하는 압력을 비교해줘.
tasks.reference_answer: IPO는 injection/casing pressure, TPO는 tubing pressure에 의해 개폐된다.
expected_claims: IPO is actuated by injection/casing pressure.
TPO is actuated by tubing pressure.

tasks.question: In cement evaluation, what does a CBL amplitude curve indicate, and what extra wave information can a VDL show?
tasks.reference_answer: CBL amplitude suggests casing-cement bond quality; VDL shows received wavetrain and can indicate casing-cement and cement-formation bond, with interpretation caveats.
expected_claims: CBL amplitude is an indicator of casing-cement bonding.
VDL wavetrain can inform both casing-cement and cement-formation bonding.

tasks.question: Edge-water drive와 bottom-water drive를 저류층에 대한 대수층의 위치로 구분해줘.
tasks.reference_answer: 대수층이 유층의 가장자리에 닿으면 edge-water, 아래쪽 바닥에 닿으면 bottom-water drive다.
expected_claims: Edge-water drive has aquifer contact at reservoir edges.
Bottom-water drive has water beneath the oil reservoir.

tasks.question: What distinct near-well interpretations do positive and negative skin factors suggest?
tasks.reference_answer: Positive skin suggests lower near-well permeability/formation damage; negative skin suggests enhanced near-well permeability, e.g. conductive fractures or channels.
expected_claims: Positive skin suggests reduced near-well permeability.
Negative skin can indicate increased near-well permeability due to conductive features.

tasks.question: Using the internal drilling-fluid equation, estimate hydrostatic pressure at TVD 8,200 ft for mud weight 13 ppg. Show the formula, psi unit, and source.
expected_claims: Uses the sourced P=0.052×MW×TVD relation.
Hydrostatic pressure is 5543.2 psi.

tasks.question: A drilling fluid has MW=11.5 ppg. According to the internal density conversion, what is its pressure gradient in psi/ft?
expected_claims: Converts mud weight using 0.052 psi/ft per ppg.
Pressure gradient is 0.598 psi/ft.

tasks.question: A site has continuous generator load 640 kW and a specified power factor of 0.8. Use the handbook relationship to calculate the minimum corresponding kVA capacity before extra allowances.
tasks.reference_answer: kVA=640/0.8=800 kVA, before any margin.
expected_claims: Uses kVA = kW / power factor.
The corresponding capacity is 800 kVA before allowances.

tasks.question: At an observation point, p1=60 psi at t1=2 h and p2=100 psi at t2=6 h. Use my equation slope=(p2-p1)/(t2-t1) and report the pressure-change slope with units.
expected_claims: Uses the user-provided finite-difference equation.
The slope is 10 psi/h.

tasks.question: Three stabilized flow rates were 70 stb/d for 2 h, 110 stb/d for 3 h, and 140 stb/d for 5 h. Find the duration-weighted mean rate, not the simple mean.
expected_claims: Uses durations as weights rather than the simple mean.
The weighted rate is 117 stb/d.

tasks.question: Bulk rock volume is 125000 m3 and porosity phi=0.16. Use the user-supplied equation PV=phi*bulk_volume to calculate pore volume.
expected_claims: Uses the explicitly supplied pore-volume relation.
Pore volume is 20000 m3.

tasks.question: A separator sample has initial liquid mass 150 kg and final mass 123 kg. Calculate the percentage decrease relative to the initial mass.
expected_claims: Uses the initial mass as the percent-change denominator.
Mass decreased by 18%.

tasks.question: A lift pump draws 185 kW continuously for 7 h. What electrical energy does it consume?
expected_claims: Energy is power multiplied by duration.
Consumption is 1295 kWh.

tasks.question: Injectivity q=240 stb/d at injection pressure 3100 psi, reservoir pressure 2800 psi. Use my definition J=q/(P_inj-P_res), calculate J, and keep its rate-per-pressure unit.
expected_claims: Uses the user's J=q/(P_inj−P_res) definition.
Injectivity is 0.8 stb/d/psi.

tasks.question: Two pressure readings are 3500 psi and 3150 psi. Compute the absolute drop and its fraction of the initial pressure; label both outputs.
tasks.reference_answer: Drop=350 psi; drop fraction=350/3500=0.10 or 10%.
expected_claims: Absolute pressure drop is 350 psi.
Fractional decrease relative to initial pressure is 0.10 (10%).

tasks.question: While planning a new drilling interval, should mud weight simply be maximized to avoid influx? State the two pressure constraints from the training material.
tasks.reference_answer: No. Mud hydrostatic pressure should exceed pore pressure but stay below fracture pressure; simply maximizing mud weight risks fracturing the formation.
expected_claims: Mud weight must provide pressure above pore pressure.
It must not exceed the formation fracture-pressure constraint.

tasks.question: When should the oil- or gas-bearing sonic-porosity correction factors from the training text be applied, and when not?
tasks.reference_answer: Only when time-average sonic porosity is obviously too high from fluid effects; not automatically for every oil- or gas-bearing rock.
expected_claims: The correction is conditional on sonic porosity being obviously too high.
It is not a universal correction for all hydrocarbon-bearing intervals.

tasks.question: A gas-lift design uses casing injection pressure as the actuating pressure. Which of IPO or TPO is consistent with that condition, and why?
tasks.reference_answer: IPO; its pressure element responds to injection/casing pressure, whereas TPO responds to tubing pressure.
expected_claims: IPO is consistent with casing/injection-pressure actuation.
TPO instead responds to tubing pressure.

tasks.question: A fault transmissibility index is nearly zero. What does that imply for across-fault flow, and how would a very high value change the interpretation?
tasks.reference_answer: Zero indicates a sealing fault and little/no across-fault communication; high values indicate negligible flow resistance and good communication.
expected_claims: Near-zero fault transmissibility implies a sealing or poorly communicating fault.
High transmissibility implies low resistance and stronger across-fault communication.

tasks.question: If only an NMR log is available after invasion, may an engineer claim it directly measures movable water in the untouched zone? Explain the limitation and what complementary log can help.
tasks.reference_answer: No. NMR has shallow invaded-zone investigation; combining NMR with deep resistivity helps assess fluids in the uninvaded zone.
expected_claims: NMR alone is shallow and reflects invaded-zone fluids.
Deep-resistivity combination can help assess uninvaded-zone fluids.

tasks.question: Is a positive well-test skin factor the same as high intrinsic reservoir permeability? Distinguish near-well damage from the unaltered formation.
tasks.reference_answer: No. Positive skin denotes reduced permeability in an altered near-well zone; it does not imply high intrinsic permeability or change the distant unaltered formation.
expected_claims: Positive skin indicates near-well permeability reduction, not high intrinsic permeability.
The unaltered formation away from the well is distinct from the damaged zone.

tasks.question: 사이드 포켓 맨드렐과 가스 리프트 밸브를 같은 장치로 부르면 왜 부정확한가?
tasks.reference_answer: 맨드렐은 포켓·포트를 가진 설치 위치이고, 밸브는 그 포켓에 장착되어 유동을 제어하는 별도 부품이다.
expected_claims: The side-pocket mandrel provides the pocket/ports.
The gas-lift valve is an installed component that controls flow.

tasks.question: Is bottom-water drive just another name for edge-water drive? Classify each by where the aquifer contacts the oil zone.
tasks.reference_answer: No. Bottom water is below the oil zone; edge water contacts its flanks/edges.
expected_claims: Bottom-water and edge-water drive refer to different aquifer locations.
Base contact is bottom-water, edge contact is edge-water drive.

tasks.question: In a microresistivity measurement, are mudcake thickness and flushed-zone resistivity Rxo interchangeable? Describe the distinct influences.
tasks.reference_answer: No. Rxo is flushed-zone resistivity; mudcake resistivity/thickness and anisotropy affect current paths and the apparent microresistivity response.
expected_claims: Rxo is a formation/flushed-zone property, not mudcake thickness.
Mudcake thickness/resistivity and anisotropy alter microresistivity measurements.

tasks.question: For WFT pressure-versus-depth interpretation, can measured depth be substituted for true vertical depth without a deviation check?
tasks.reference_answer: No. Pressure gradient should be plotted versus TVD; the measured-to-TVD conversion and depth match must be quality checked.
expected_claims: WFT pressure-depth interpretation depends on true vertical depth.
Measured-to-TVD conversion and depth matching require QC.

tasks.question: The safest drilling rule is that mud hydrostatic pressure may exceed fracture pressure as long as it exceeds pore pressure, correct? Check the internal drilling text.
tasks.reference_answer: Incorrect. The mud pressure should exceed pore pressure but remain below fracture pressure.
expected_claims: Explicitly rejects the premise that exceeding fracture pressure is safe.
Corrects the mud-pressure window to above pore pressure and below fracture pressure.

tasks.question: 음의 skin factor는 손상 때문에 근정의 투과도가 감소했다는 뜻이지? 내부 근거로 검토해줘.
tasks.reference_answer: 아니다. 음의 skin은 근정 투과도 증가나 전도성 균열/채널과 관련될 수 있고, 감소·손상은 양의 skin 해석이다.
expected_claims: Explicitly rejects negative skin as evidence of reduced near-well permeability.
States that positive skin suggests damage while negative skin can reflect conductive enhancement.

tasks.question: An IPO gas-lift valve is controlled by tubing pressure, whereas TPO is controlled by casing pressure. Is that how the training material defines them?
tasks.reference_answer: No; the relationship is reversed. IPO responds to injection/casing pressure and TPO to tubing pressure.
expected_claims: Explicitly rejects the swapped IPO/TPO pressure assignment.
Correctly assigns casing/injection to IPO and tubing to TPO.

tasks.question: VDL에 곧은 평행선만 보이면 케이싱-시멘트 및 시멘트-지층 결합이 양호하다는 뜻이지?
tasks.reference_answer: 아니다. 결합이 양호할 때는 지층 경유 신호의 물결 모양이 나타나고, 결합이 나쁘면 평행선이 계속될 수 있다.
expected_claims: Explicitly rejects parallel-only VDL lines as evidence of good bonding.
States that wavy formation signals support good bond whereas persistent parallel lines can indicate poor bond.

tasks.question: For my unnamed reservoir, what is the exact absolute permeability in mD? I have provided no core, log, or pressure-transient data.
tasks.reference_answer: Cannot determine a site-specific permeability without measurements or sufficient reservoir data; request appropriate core/log/test data.
expected_claims: States that exact permeability cannot be determined from the provided information.
Requests relevant measurements rather than inventing a value.

tasks.question: Give the one exact safe mud weight for my planned well, but I am not sharing pore-pressure, fracture-gradient, or depth information.
tasks.reference_answer: An exact safe mud weight cannot be calculated without pore/fracture pressure versus depth and well context; ask for those inputs.
expected_claims: Does not fabricate a numerical safe mud weight.
Identifies pore/fracture pressure and depth as missing constraints.

tasks.question: A CO2 storage prospect is at 1,900 m depth. What exact in-situ CO2 density should I use? No temperature, pressure, composition, or EOS is specified.
tasks.reference_answer: Depth alone cannot establish exact in-situ CO2 density; pressure, temperature, composition and a suitable EOS/property method are needed.
expected_claims: Rejects an exact density from depth alone.
Requests pressure, temperature, composition and a property model.

tasks.question: Predict the exact cumulative aquifer influx for our field next year. I have provided no geometry, aquifer properties, pressure history, production schedule, or influx model.
tasks.reference_answer: Cannot quantify cumulative water influx without aquifer geometry/properties, pressure-production history and a specified model or calibration.
expected_claims: Does not invent an exact water-influx volume.
Identifies missing aquifer/reservoir history and model inputs.

tasks.question: Select the exact depth of the first gas-lift valve in my new well, with no tubing, pressures, fluid gradient, or injection-gas data provided.
tasks.reference_answer: Cannot set a unique valve depth without well geometry/tubing, pressure profiles, fluid gradients and injection-gas conditions; ask for these.
expected_claims: Does not invent an exact gas-lift valve depth.
Requests the missing well and injection design data.
